sourceTitle: The Art of Being Happy In a Series of Letters from a Father to His Children: with Observations and Comments
description: "The Art of Being Happy" by Joseph Droz is a philosophical treatise composed of letters, likely written in the early 19th century. The work is framed as a series of letters from a father imparting wisdom to his children about happiness and the pursuit of a fulfilling life.
